---
title: "First Steps"
---

This freely accessible collection is a starting point for learning with everyday
data. All activities are ungraded. You need no computer or account.

Begin with [First Steps](courses/first-steps/index.qmd).

This starter has no progress controls. If browser-local tracking is added later,
it will need a clear notice: progress stays in the same browser and profile on
the same device, does not sync, and can be lost when browser data is cleared.
